questions.question: Six friends are sitting on a circular table, facing towards the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). X is to the immediate left of Z and W is to the immediate right of Y. Z and U are separated by only one person sitting between them. W is an immediate neighbour of U. Only V is sitting between Z and Y. Who among the following are the immediate neighbours of U?
questions.solution:
Given: Six friends are sitting on a circular table, facing towards the centre.

1) X is to the immediate left of Z and W is to the immediate right of Y.

2) Only V is sitting between Z and Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d38de813db5303882f3ab5d410013969cb07b8cb95dab7009a9e9597c112d87b.png] 

3) Z and U are separated by only one person sitting between them. 

4) W is an immediate neighbour of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59eeefe07c6baca9de4f5efbe91693354721509692dcaa4ba5893d741a97acb8.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, X and W are the immediate neighbours of U.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

questions.question:

Given : 17 + 77 − 7 x 37 ÷ 47 = ?

According to the question, after '+' and 'x' are interchanged and '−' and '÷' are interchanged:

17 + 77 − 7 x 37 ÷ 47 = ? ⇒ 17 x 77 ÷ 7 + 37 - 47 = ?

⇒ 17 x __**77 **____**÷**____** 7**__ + 37 - 47 = ?

⇒ __**17 x 11**__ + 37 - 47 = ?

⇒ __**187**____** + 37**__ - 47 = ?

⇒ __224____** - 47**__ = ?

⇒ **177 = ?**

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
10 is related to 75 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 6 is related to 47. To which of the following is 15 related following the same logic?

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
questions.solution:
Logic followed here is,

**(First number × 7) + 5 = Second number**

Given, 

10 × 7 + 5 = 75(Second number)

6 × 7 + 5 = 47(Second number)

Now, for 15

15 × 7 + 5 = **110**

So correct answer is **Option 2.**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

Some whales are sharks.

No shark is a dolphin.

**Conclusions:**

(I) No dolphin is a shark.

(II) Some sharks are whales.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/062f04c5dc49979e02c507ce9dc0581ec6bb708398993593516895f15de4e1f0.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No dolphin is a shark → Follow (As no shark is a dolphin. As direct relation is given between sharks and dolphin, therefore it is true.)

(II) Some sharks are whales → Follow (As some whales are sharks. As some part of whales is common with sharks, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All shirts are trousers.

No trouser is a belt.

**Conclusions:**

(I) No shirt is a belt.

(II) Some belts may be trousers.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/480389511aafebf28b2e0db5f55711b4228efb7acba7612f12c2e3d90bbdf7db.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) No shirt is a belt → Follow (As all shirts are trousers and no trouser is a belt. As whole shirts comes in trousers which cannot be belt, therefore it is false.)

(II) Some belts may be trousers → Does not follow (As no trouser is a belt. As no trouser cannot be belt, therefore it is false.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
